Overview

San José is a city in SJ with a population of 1,500,000. Costa Rica’s capital and cultural heart, a vibrant Central American city surrounded by lush mountains and coffee plantations. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.0.
